newsitem.title: USA: Western Pacific Nov load factor falls.
newsitem.headline: Western Pacific Nov load factor falls.

text.p: Western Pacific Airlines Inc said on Wednesday that its November load factor fell to 59.1 percent from 64.1 percent in November 1995.

The number of available seat miles in November increased to 220.2 million from 136.0 million in November 1995, while revenue passenger miles increase to 130.2 million from 87.2 million, the carrier said.

November departures increased 41 percent to 1,861 from 1,317 in the year ago period, Western Pacific said. Total passengers increased 30 percent to 148,154 in November from 113,969 in November 1995, the carrier said.
